title: 天文自適應光學
summary: 以 ESO VLT 自適應光學設施（1170 致動器的變形副鏡）與 ELT 的 2.4 m、5000 餘致動器 M4 為範本：從 r0、Greenwood 頻率與等暈角推出變形鏡與波前感測器的規格，再把擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊與非共光路像差整合成 Strehl 預算，最後以即時控制迴路與天上驗證完成工程交接。
summaryEn: Using the ESO VLT Adaptive Optics Facility with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and the 2.4 m, 5000-plus-actuator M4 of the ELT as templates: derive deformable-mirror and wavefront-sensor specifications from r0, the Greenwood frequency and the isoplanatic angle, assemble fitting, temporal, measurement and non-common-path terms into a Strehl budget, and close with real-time control dynamics and on-sky validation for engineering handoff.

scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.textEn: Strehl-budget exercise: VLT 8.2 m, K band at 2.2 µm, seeing 0.7″ (r0 = 14.4 cm at 500 nm → 85 cm at K), wind 10 m/s, a 1170-actuator deformable secondary (projected pitch 0.21 m), a 1 kHz loop with f_3dB = 50 Hz and a bright on-axis NGS. Fitting: 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) = 0.028 rad²; temporal: f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 = 5.0 Hz, (5.0/50)^(5/3) = 0.022; measurement: 500 photons per subaperture per frame, π²/(2×500)×(0.7/2.2)² = 0.001; aliasing 0.008; NCPA 50 nm → (2π×50/2200)² = 0.020; other 0.010. Total σ² = 0.089 → exp(−0.089) = 0.915; jitter 10 mas → S_j = 0.86; Strehl ≈ 0.79. If the guide star fades to 10 photons per frame the measurement term rises to 0.05, σ² = 0.138 → 0.871×0.86 ≈ 0.75; if seeing worsens to 1.2″ the fitting and temporal terms each grow by 2.45, σ² ≈ 0.21 → Strehl ≈ 0.70. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real system's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度」與「時間相干、角相干與迴路速度需求」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大氣折射率的隨機起伏由溫度微差造成，其結構遵循 Kolmogorov 統計，強度以 C_n²(h) 剖面描述。沿視線積分後得到 Fried 參數 r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5)，它是波前相位變異量達到 1 rad² 的孔徑直徑：直徑大於 r0 的望遠鏡，長曝光影像不再隨口徑變銳，而被視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0 限制。因為 k = 2π/λ，r0 ∝ λ^(6/5)，所以同一片大氣在紅外線顯得平靜得多，這是近紅外成為自適應光學主戰場的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Random refractive-index fluctuations of the air arise from small temperature differences and follow Kolmogorov statistics, with strength described by the C_n²(h) profile. Integrating along the line of sight gives the Fried parameter r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5), the aperture diameter over which the wavefront phase variance reaches 1 rad²: a telescope larger than r0 gains no further sharpness in long exposures and is limited by the seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0. Because k = 2π/λ, r0 ∝ λ^(6/5), so the same atmosphere looks far calmer in the infrared, which is why the near-infrared is the main arena of adaptive optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Paranal median seeing of 0.7″ at 500 nm: r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm; at K band (2.2 µm) r0 = 14.4 cm×(2.2/0.5)^(6/5) ≈ 14.4×5.92 ≈ 85 cm; the K-band seeing FWHM = 0.98×2.2×10⁻⁶/0.85 ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.52″, whereas the diffraction limit λ/D of an 8.2 m telescope is ≈ 0.055″, a factor 9.4 that AO must recover.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「望遠鏡口徑越大，長曝光影像就越銳利。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger telescope aperture always gives sharper long-exposure images." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Paranal 中位視寧度 0.7″（500 nm）：r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm；換到 K 波段 2.2 µm，r0 = 14.4 cm×(2.2/0.5)^(6/5) ≈ 14.4×5.92 ≈ 85 cm；K 波段視寧度 FWHM = 0.98×2.2×10⁻⁶/0.85 ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.52″，而 8.2 m 望遠鏡的繞射極限 λ/D ≈ 0.055″，差 9.4 倍，這就是 AO 要補回的銳度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Paranal median seeing of 0.7″ at 500 nm: r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm; at K band (2.2 µm) r0 = 14.4 cm×(2.2/0.5)^(6/5) ≈ 14.4×5.92 ≈ 85 cm; the K-band seeing FWHM = 0.98×2.2×10⁻⁶/0.85 ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.52″, whereas the diffraction limit λ/D of an 8.2 m telescope is ≈ 0.055″, a factor 9.4 that AO must recover. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用台址的 DIMM（差分影像運動監測儀）量 r0 並換算視寧度，與同時間科學影像的 FWHM 比較；以 MASS 或 SCIDAR 量 C_n²(h) 剖面，積分後核對是否重現 DIMM 的 r0；在兩個波段同時成像，確認 FWHM 比值符合 λ^(−1/5) 的視寧度尺度關係。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure r0 with the site DIMM (differential image motion monitor) and convert to seeing, comparing with the FWHM of simultaneous science images; measure the C_n²(h) profile with MASS or SCIDAR and integrate it to check that it reproduces the DIMM r0; image in two bands at once and confirm the FWHM ratio follows the λ^(−1/5) seeing scaling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用台址的 DIMM（差分影像運動監測儀）量 r0 並換算視寧度，與同時間科學影像的 FWHM 比較；以 MASS 或 SCIDAR 量 C_n²(h) 剖面，積分後核對是否重現 DIMM 的 r0；在兩個波段同時成像，確認 FWHM 比值符合 λ^(−1/5) 的視寧度尺度關係。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure r0 with the site DIMM (differential image motion monitor) and convert to seeing, comparing with the FWHM of simultaneous science images; measure the C_n²(h) profile with MASS or SCIDAR and integrate it to check that it reproduces the DIMM r0; image in two bands at once and confirm the FWHM ratio follows the λ^(−1/5) seeing scaling. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 r0 當成與波長無關的常數，用可見光的 r0 去設計紅外 AO，會把致動器數與迴路頻率高估數倍；反之用紅外的 r0 設計可見光感測器，則子孔徑太大而讓波前量測失效。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating r0 as wavelength-independent and designing an infrared AO system with the visible r0 overestimates actuator count and loop rate by several times; using the infrared r0 for a visible-light sensor instead makes the subapertures too large and the wavefront measurement fails.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 時間相干、角相干與迴路速度需求：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Temporal and angular coherence and the loop-rate requirement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 湍流層被風以速度 v 吹過孔徑，相位圖樣以 Taylor 凍結流假設平移，波前的特徵頻率是 Greenwood 頻率 f_G = 0.427·v/r0；若控制迴路的 −3 dB 頻寬是 f_3dB，殘餘的時間誤差為 σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3)。另一個限制是角度：相隔 θ 的兩條視線穿過不同的湍流，殘差 σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3)，等暈角 θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ 由湍流的加權平均高度 h̄ 決定。這兩個量分別規定了波前感測器的幀率與參考星必須離目標多近，也直接引出雷射導星與多共軛 AO 的需求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

These two quantities fix the wavefront-sensor frame rate and how close the reference star must be, and lead directly to laser guide stars and multi-conjugate AO. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 變形鏡：致動器密度、行程與擬合誤差：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「變形副鏡與 ELT M4」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deformable secondary and ELT M4” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：VLT：瞳面積 π/4×8.2² ≈ 52.8 m²，52.8/1170 ≈ 0.045 m²／致動器，投影間距 d ≈ 0.21 m；K 波段 r0 = 0.85 m，σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.28×0.099 ≈ 0.028 rad²。ELT：有效瞳面積約 1100 m²，1100/5316 ≈ 0.21 m²，d ≈ 0.45 m，σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.45/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.097 rad²，單由擬合項得到 Strehl ≈ 0.91。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: VLT: pupil area π/4×8.2² ≈ 52.8 m², 52.8/1170 ≈ 0.045 m² per actuator, projected pitch d ≈ 0.21 m; with r0 = 0.85 m at K, σ_fit² = 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) ≈ 0.28×0.099 ≈ 0.028 rad². Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以干涉儀量每個致動器的影響函數（influence function）與鄰接耦合比，確認行程、線性度與遲滯；對薄殼施加 Zernike 組合並量閉迴路後的面形殘差；用電容感測器的讀值做迴路頻率響應，確認 1 kHz 更新下的穩定餘裕；以高解析度干涉圖計算實際擬合誤差並與 0.28(d/r0)^(5/3) 比較。

steps.instruction: Shack–Hartmann 感測器用微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個子孔徑的光點位移正比於該處的波前斜率；金字塔感測器則在焦點放一個四面稜鏡，以四個瞳影像的強度差量斜率，對小像差的靈敏度更高。光點位置的量測受光子雜訊限制，每個子孔徑每幀只有數十到數百個光子，所以必須用讀出雜訊低於 1 e⁻ 的 EMCCD 或專用低雜訊紅外偵測器（ELT 的 LISA 由 ESO 與 Teledyne 共同開發）。感測波長的相位誤差換算到科學波段要乘 (λ_s/λ_sci)²。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 控制器需要知道每個致動器動作時感測器看到什麼：逐一（或以 Hadamard 圖樣）推拉致動器，記錄斜率向量，組成交互矩陣 D；以奇異值分解取偽逆得到控制矩陣，並截去奇異值過小、雜訊放大過大的模態。感測器與科學相機之間的光路不同，科學焦點上存在感測器看不見的非共光路像差（NCPA），必須用相位分集或 PSF 最佳化在科學相機上量出，再轉成感測器的參考斜率偏置。模態基底（Karhunen–Loève）讓每個模態可以有不同的增益。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The controller must know what the sensor sees when each actuator moves: push–pull each actuator (or Hadamard patterns), record the slope vector and assemble the interaction matrix D; a singular-value decomposition gives the pseudo-inverse control matrix after truncating modes whose small singular values would amplify noise. Because the optical paths to the sensor and to the science camera differ, non-common-path aberrations (NCPA) invisible to the sensor exist at the science focus; they are measured on the science camera by phase diversity or PSF optimisation and converted into reference-slope offsets for the sensor. A modal basis (Karhunen–Loève) allows each mode its own gain. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：量 1170 個致動器的交互矩陣：每個致動器推拉各平均 10 幀，共 1170×2×10 = 23,400 幀，在 1 kHz 下 23.4 s；若改用 Hadamard 圖樣，同樣時間內每個元素的訊噪比提高 √1170 ≈ 34 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Measuring the interaction matrix of 1170 actuators with 10 averaged frames per push and per pull takes 1170×2×10 = 23,400 frames, 23.4 s at 1 kHz; Hadamard patterns raise the signal-to-noise of each element by √1170 ≈ 34 in the same time.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器殘差最小時，科學影像的 Strehl 一定最高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Minimum sensor residual always means maximum science-image Strehl." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量 1170 個致動器的交互矩陣：每個致動器推拉各平均 10 幀，共 1170×2×10 = 23,400 幀，在 1 kHz 下 23.4 s；若改用 Hadamard 圖樣，同樣時間內每個元素的訊噪比提高 √1170 ≈ 34 倍。NCPA 殘差 50 nm rms 在 K 波段對應 σ² = (2π×50/2200)² ≈ 0.020 rad²，Strehl 損失約 2%；若未校正而殘留 150 nm，σ² ≈ 0.18 rad²，Strehl 損失 17%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Measuring the interaction matrix of 1170 actuators with 10 averaged frames per push and per pull takes 1170×2×10 = 23,400 frames, 23.4 s at 1 kHz; Hadamard patterns raise the signal-to-noise of each element by √1170 ≈ 34 in the same time. An NCPA residual of 50 nm rms corresponds at K to σ² = (2π×50/2200)² ≈ 0.020 rad², a Strehl loss of about 2%; left uncalibrated at 150 nm, σ² ≈ 0.18 rad² and the loss is 17%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較實測交互矩陣與由影響函數和感測器幾何模擬出的合成矩陣，核對各模態的奇異值譜；閉迴路後對內部光源量感測器殘差與科學相機 PSF，確認 NCPA 偏置使科學 Strehl 最大化而非感測器殘差最小化；用相位分集重建科學焦點的波前並與偏置比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the measured interaction matrix with a synthetic one simulated from influence functions and sensor geometry, checking the singular-value spectrum of the modes; after closing the loop on an internal source, measure both the sensor residual and the science-camera PSF to confirm that the NCPA offsets maximise science Strehl rather than minimise sensor residual; reconstruct the science-focus wavefront by phase diversity and compare with the offsets.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interaction matrix, modal control and NCPA calibration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 比較實測交互矩陣與由影響函數和感測器幾何模擬出的合成矩陣，核對各模態的奇異值譜；閉迴路後對內部光源量感測器殘差與科學相機 PSF，確認 NCPA 偏置使科學 Strehl 最大化而非感測器殘差最小化；用相位分集重建科學焦點的波前並與偏置比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the measured interaction matrix with a synthetic one simulated from influence functions and sensor geometry, checking the singular-value spectrum of the modes; after closing the loop on an internal source, measure both the sensor residual and the science-camera PSF to confirm that the NCPA offsets maximise science Strehl rather than minimise sensor residual; reconstruct the science-focus wavefront by phase diversity and compare with the offsets. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交互矩陣在望遠鏡水平位置量測，而觀測時重力改變了感測器與變形鏡的對位（註冊誤差），矩陣中的致動器與子孔徑錯位半格，迴路雖然收斂卻把能量推到錯誤的模態，Strehl 比預算低且隨高度角變化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An interaction matrix measured with the telescope horizontal no longer matches when gravity shifts the registration between sensor and deformable mirror during observation; actuators and subapertures are misaligned by half a cell, the loop converges but pushes energy into wrong modes, and the Strehl falls below budget and varies with elevation.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 誤差預算與 Strehl 比：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Error budget and the Strehl ratio: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Strehl 預算表」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strehl budget table” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: AO 的效能用 Strehl 比衡量：在小像差下 S ≈ exp(−σ²)，σ² 是所有殘餘相位變異的總和（以 rad² 計），各項彼此獨立時直接相加。主要項目是擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊、混疊（感測器對高頻的錯誤取樣，約為擬合項的三成）、非等暈、NCPA 與色散；影像抖動（tip-tilt 與振動）不屬於小像差，另以 S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²] 的因子乘上。預算表讓工程師知道哪一項值得花錢，也決定哪種視寧度下系統值得開迴路。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Strehl 預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: AO performance is judged by the Strehl ratio: for small aberrations S ≈ exp(−σ²), where σ² is the sum of all residual phase variances in rad², added directly when the terms are independent. The main terms are fitting, temporal delay, measurement noise, aliasing (the sensor mis-sampling high frequencies, roughly 30% of the fitting term), anisoplanatism, NCPA and chromatic effects; image jitter from tip-tilt and vibration is not a small aberration and is applied as a separate factor S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²]. The budget table tells the engineer which term is worth money and under what seeing the loop is worth closing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Strehl budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: K band, bright on-axis NGS: fitting 0.028 + temporal 0.022 + measurement 0.001 + aliasing 0.008 + NCPA 0.020 + chromatic and other 0.010 = 0.089 rad² → exp(−0.089) ≈ 0.915; jitter σ_j = 10 mas = 4.85×10⁻⁸ rad with λ/D = 2.68×10⁻⁷ rad gives S_j = 1/[1 + 4.93×(0.181)²] ≈ 0.86; total Strehl ≈ 0.915×0.86 ≈ 0.79.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Strehl 只由變形鏡的致動器數量決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Strehl is determined only by the number of deformable-mirror actuators." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Strehl 預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Strehl 預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strehl budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：K 波段、亮 NGS 在軸上：擬合 0.028 + 時間 0.022 + 量測 0.001 + 混疊 0.008 + NCPA 0.020 + 色散與其他 0.010 = 0.089 rad² → exp(−0.089) ≈ 0.915；抖動 σ_j = 10 mas = 4.85×10⁻⁸ rad，λ/D = 2.68×10⁻⁷ rad，S_j = 1/[1 + 4.93×(0.181)²] ≈ 0.86；總 Strehl ≈ 0.915×0.86 ≈ 0.79。換到 H 波段（1.65 µm）各項乘 (2.2/1.65)² = 1.78，σ² = 0.158 → 0.85，S_j ≈ 0.78，總 Strehl ≈ 0.66。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

At H band (1.65 µm) every term is multiplied by (2.2/1.65)² = 1.78, σ² = 0.158 → 0.85, S_j ≈ 0.78, total Strehl ≈ 0.66. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從閉迴路遙測重建殘餘波前並按模態分解，把各項變異量與預算表逐項比較；用科學相機的 PSF 以與繞射極限 PSF 相同總通量歸一化量實際 Strehl；以加速度計量望遠鏡振動譜並估抖動項；在不同視寧度下重複，畫出 Strehl 對 r0 的曲線與預算模型比對。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Strehl budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從閉迴路遙測重建殘餘波前並按模態分解，把各項變異量與預算表逐項比較；用科學相機的 PSF 以與繞射極限 PSF 相同總通量歸一化量實際 Strehl；以加速度計量望遠鏡振動譜並估抖動項；在不同視寧度下重複，畫出 Strehl 對 r0 的曲線與預算模型比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「即時控制器與迴路延遲」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Real-time controller and loop latency” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 即時控制器每幀讀取相機、算出斜率、以控制矩陣做一次矩陣向量乘法得到致動器指令，再加上積分器；整個路徑的延遲包含曝光、讀出、計算與致動器響應。積分控制的開迴路交越頻率約為 g·f_s/(2π)，但純延遲 τ_d 在交越頻率處造成 360°·f·τ_d 的相位落後，疊加積分器的 90°，相位裕度隨增益上升而消失，所以迴路頻寬受延遲而非運算能力限制。ESO 的 SPARTA 平台與 ELT 的即時控制在 500–1000 Hz 下運作，ELT 的 M4 指令每秒 1000 次。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「即時控制器與迴路延遲」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each frame the real-time controller reads the camera, computes slopes, performs one matrix-vector multiply with the control matrix to obtain actuator commands and applies an integrator; the end-to-end latency includes exposure, readout, computation and actuator response. For integral control the open-loop crossover is about g·f_s/(2π), but a pure delay τ_d adds a phase lag of 360°·f·τ_d at crossover on top of the integrator's 90°, so phase margin vanishes as gain rises and loop bandwidth is limited by latency rather than computing power. ESO's SPARTA platform and the ELT real-time control run at 500–1000 Hz, with M4 commands issued 1000 times per second. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Real-time controller and loop latency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f_s = 1 kHz with gain g = 0.5: crossover ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz; a delay τ_d = 2 frames = 2 ms adds 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° of lag at 80 Hz, leaving a phase margin of 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°; to keep 45° of margin, f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz, i.e. g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「即時控制器的運算速度越快，迴路頻寬就越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A faster real-time computer always gives higher loop bandwidth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「即時控制器與迴路延遲」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Real-time controller and loop latency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「即時控制器與迴路延遲」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Real-time controller and loop latency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f_s = 1 kHz、增益 g = 0.5：交越頻率 ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz；延遲 τ_d = 2 幀 = 2 ms 在 80 Hz 造成 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° 落後，相位裕度 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°；要維持 45° 裕度，f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz，對應 g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39。運算量：2480 個斜率 × 1170 致動器 ≈ 2.9×10⁶ 次乘加／幀，1 kHz 下 2.9 GMAC/s；ELT 約 10⁴ 斜率 × 5316 ≈ 5.3×10⁷／幀，500 Hz 下 27 GMAC/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f_s = 1 kHz with gain g = 0.5: crossover ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz; a delay τ_d = 2 frames = 2 ms adds 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° of lag at 80 Hz, leaving a phase margin of 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°; to keep 45° of margin, f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz, i.e. g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39. Computation: 2480 slopes × 1170 actuators ≈ 2.9×10⁶ multiply-accumulates per frame, 2.9 GMAC/s at 1 kHz; for the ELT about 10⁴ slopes × 5316 ≈ 5.3×10⁷ per frame, 27 GMAC/s at 500 Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在閉迴路中注入已知正弦擾動（經變形鏡或參考斜率）量抑制傳遞函數，找出 0 dB 頻率與過衝峰，與含延遲的模型比較；用時間戳記量從曝光中點到致動器到位的端到端延遲；掃描增益直到迴路出現振盪，記錄臨界增益並與相位裕度預測對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject known sinusoidal disturbances in closed loop (through the deformable mirror or the reference slopes) and measure the rejection transfer function, locating the 0 dB frequency and the overshoot peak against a model with delay; time-stamp the end-to-end latency from mid-exposure to actuator arrival; scan the gain until the loop oscillates and compare the critical gain with the phase-margin prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: f_s = 1 kHz with gain g = 0.5: crossover ≈ 0.5×1000/(2π) ≈ 80 Hz; a delay τ_d = 2 frames = 2 ms adds 360°×80×0.002 ≈ 58° of lag at 80 Hz, leaving a phase margin of 180° − 90° − 58° ≈ 32°; to keep 45° of margin, f_c = 45/(360×0.002) ≈ 62 Hz, i.e. g ≈ 2π×62/1000 ≈ 0.39. Computation: 2480 slopes × 1170 actuators ≈ 2.9×10⁶ multiply-accumulates per frame, 2.9 GMAC/s at 1 kHz; for the ELT about 10⁴ slopes × 5316 ≈ 5.3×10⁷ per frame, 27 GMAC/s at 500 Hz.

steps.title: 即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「即時控制器與迴路延遲」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Real-time controller and loop latency” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在閉迴路中注入已知正弦擾動（經變形鏡或參考斜率）量抑制傳遞函數，找出 0 dB 頻率與過衝峰，與含延遲的模型比較；用時間戳記量從曝光中點到致動器到位的端到端延遲；掃描增益直到迴路出現振盪，記錄臨界增益並與相位裕度預測對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inject known sinusoidal disturbances in closed loop (through the deformable mirror or the reference slopes) and measure the rejection transfer function, locating the 0 dB frequency and the overshoot peak against a model with delay; time-stamp the end-to-end latency from mid-exposure to actuator arrival; scan the gain until the loop oscillates and compare the critical gain with the phase-margin prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了追求頻寬把增益調到 0.8，相位裕度降到接近零，抑制函數在 100–150 Hz 出現 +6 dB 的過衝峰，正好放大望遠鏡振動與風擾，殘差反而比低增益時更大。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising the gain to 0.8 in pursuit of bandwidth drives the phase margin toward zero, the rejection function develops a +6 dB overshoot peak at 100–150 Hz that amplifies telescope vibration and wind shake, and the residual becomes larger than at low gain.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在閉迴路中注入已知正弦擾動（經變形鏡或參考斜率）量抑制傳遞函數，找出 0 dB 頻率與過衝峰，與含延遲的模型比較；用時間戳記量從曝光中點到致動器到位的端到端延遲；掃描增益直到迴路出現振盪，記錄臨界增益並與相位裕度預測對照。
knowledge.textEn: Inject known sinusoidal disturbances in closed loop (through the deformable mirror or the reference slopes) and measure the rejection transfer function, locating the 0 dB frequency and the overshoot peak against a model with delay; time-stamp the end-to-end latency from mid-exposure to actuator arrival; scan the gain until the loop oscillates and compare the critical gain with the phase-margin prediction.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「即時控制：矩陣乘法、延遲與相位裕度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Real-time control: matrix multiply, latency and phase margin"?
options: 在閉迴路中注入已知正弦擾動（經變形鏡或參考斜率）量抑制傳遞函數，找出 0 dB 頻率與過衝峰，與含延遲的模型比較。

steps.instruction: 系統在天上的驗證包含：對不同星等與離軸角的參考星閉迴路，量 Strehl、FWHM 與包圍能量；同步記錄感測器與變形鏡遙測，重建殘餘相位的功率譜並反推 PSF；在一系列視寧度與相干時間下建立效能對台址條件的統計。交接文件必須給出操作限制（例如 τ0 下限、視寧度上限、星等範圍）、校正檔的版本（交互矩陣、NCPA 偏置、參考斜率）、振動與延遲的量測值，以及每次重新校正的觸發條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

The handoff record must state operating limits (such as a τ0 floor, a seeing ceiling and the magnitude range), the versions of calibration files (interaction matrix, NCPA offsets, reference slopes), the measured vibration and latency, and the conditions that trigger recalibration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “On-sky validation and telemetry record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：量到 Strehl 後反推殘差：σ = √(−ln S)，S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad，在 K 波段為 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms；S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm。

steps.title: 天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “On-sky validation and telemetry record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量到 Strehl 後反推殘差：σ = √(−ln S)，S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad，在 K 波段為 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms；S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm。操作上限：視寧度 1.2″ 時 r0(500 nm) = 8.4 cm，擬合項放大 (14.4/8.4)^(5/3) ≈ 2.45 倍到 0.068 rad²，時間項同樣放大，K 波段總 σ² 從 0.089 升到約 0.21，Strehl 降到 0.81×0.86 ≈ 0.70（仍可用）；視寧度 2″ 則 σ² ≈ 0.5，Strehl 約 0.5。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Back out the residual from a measured Strehl: σ = √(−ln S), so S = 0.5 → σ = 0.83 rad, which at K is 0.83×2200/(2π) ≈ 290 nm rms; S = 0.8 → 0.47 rad ≈ 165 nm. Operating ceiling: at 1.2″ seeing r0(500 nm) = 8.4 cm, the fitting term grows by (14.4/8.4)^(5/3) ≈ 2.45 to 0.068 rad² and the temporal term likewise, the K-band total σ² rises from 0.089 to about 0.21 and the Strehl drops to 0.81×0.86 ≈ 0.70, still usable; at 2″ seeing σ² ≈ 0.5 and the Strehl is about 0.5. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對同一顆亮星在整夜不同視寧度下重複量 Strehl，與 DIMM/MASS 的 r0、τ0 繪成散佈圖並擬合預算模型；用遙測重建的 PSF 與實際科學影像的 PSF 比較其 FWHM 與暈的強度；核對交接文件中每個校正檔的雜湊值與生效日期，並做一次由新操作員依文件重做的完整校正流程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the Strehl on the same bright star repeatedly through a night of changing seeing, scatter it against the DIMM/MASS r0 and τ0 and fit the budget model; compare the telemetry-reconstructed PSF with the real science PSF in FWHM and halo strength; check the hash and validity date of every calibration file in the handoff record and have a new operator repeat the full calibration sequence from the document alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。

steps.title: 天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “On-sky validation and telemetry record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對同一顆亮星在整夜不同視寧度下重複量 Strehl，與 DIMM/MASS 的 r0、τ0 繪成散佈圖並擬合預算模型；用遙測重建的 PSF 與實際科學影像的 PSF 比較其 FWHM 與暈的強度；核對交接文件中每個校正檔的雜湊值與生效日期，並做一次由新操作員依文件重做的完整校正流程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the Strehl on the same bright star repeatedly through a night of changing seeing, scatter it against the DIMM/MASS r0 and τ0 and fit the budget model; compare the telemetry-reconstructed PSF with the real science PSF in FWHM and halo strength; check the hash and validity date of every calibration file in the handoff record and have a new operator repeat the full calibration sequence from the document alone. steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時未記錄 NCPA 偏置所對應的儀器配置（濾鏡、焦點位置），換濾鏡後沿用舊偏置，科學影像的 Strehl 無聲地下降 10–20%，感測器殘差卻完全正常，問題要到比對歸檔 PSF 時才被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the instrument configuration (filter, focus position) tied to the NCPA offsets is not recorded at handoff, old offsets are reused after a filter change, the science Strehl silently drops 10–20% while sensor residuals look perfectly normal, and the problem surfaces only when archived PSFs are compared.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “On-sky validation and telemetry record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時未記錄 NCPA 偏置所對應的儀器配置（濾鏡、焦點位置），換濾鏡後沿用舊偏置，科學影像的 Strehl 無聲地下降 10–20%，感測器殘差卻完全正常，問題要到比對歸檔 PSF 時才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the instrument configuration (filter, focus position) tied to the NCPA offsets is not recorded at handoff, old offsets are reused after a filter change, the science Strehl silently drops 10–20% while sensor residuals look perfectly normal, and the problem surfaces only when archived PSFs are compared. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須給出操作限制（例如 τ0 下限、視寧度上限、星等範圍）、校正檔的版本（交互矩陣、NCPA 偏置、參考斜率）、振動與延遲的量測值，以及每次重新校正的觸發條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must state operating limits (such as a τ0 floor, a seeing ceiling and the magnitude range), the versions of calibration files (interaction matrix, NCPA offsets, reference slopes), the measured vibration and latency, and the conditions that trigger recalibration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器殘差正常，系統就不需要再做天上驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal sensor residuals mean no on-sky validation is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
